eventName: The Art of Being Everywhere at Once
storyName: The Art of Being Everywhere at Once
storyInfo: The process of rebuilding Rhodes Island has forced Closure to wring out every last drop of ingenuity she has, and while she's still hanging on by a thread, that thread is just about ready to snap...

attributes.content: Doctor, Amiya, Closure, this plate is yours now.
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: We've had to rush getting it to you. There's a lot of facilities about the plate that still need repairs. Odds are, it'll be asking a lot of TLC from you—
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.options: The industry capacity is a rare luxury in Londinium.

attributes.content: I know. It's just...
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: Londinium only emerged from the ashes of war not long ago. Given Victoria's current situation, it can't afford to divert so much production into one single plate.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Exactly. Heck, look how much you managed to optimize the plate structure for us. You are lifesavers.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Siege, you've done far, far more than we could ask for already. Thank you. So, so much.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Compared to what Rhodes Island does, it's a drop in the bucket—
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.options: Says the Siege of Rhodes Island?

attributes.content: ...Fair dos.
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: Once Rhodes is rebuilt, I'll pop by the Training Room as soon as I can.
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.options: I'll get you a top sparring partner. Top of the top.

attributes.content: Haha, deal!
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: Madam Speaker, we can't afford to dawdle any further, else we won't be in time for the next grand opening...
attributes.name: Sympathetic Assistant

attributes.content: Right then, everyone, see you later—
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: Madam Speaker, photos, photos!
attributes.name: Sympathetic Assistant

attributes.content: ...*sigh*.
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: Well... as representative of Londinium, I hereby express my most solemn grief for the losses you have suffered, and my most sincere condolences. May we meet once more upon a reborn Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Vina

attributes.content: Vina extends a hand.
The Doctor and Amiya shoot simultaneous glances at the same woman, who is presently lost in a stupor.

attributes.options: (Closure.);......;(Hiss) Closure.

attributes.content: Whuh!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: As representative of Rhodes Island, I thank Victoria for its support in the Rhodes Island reconstruction efforts, and I look forward to the day we meet again, Vin—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Sorry, Sie—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Madam Speaker Alexandrina.

attributes.content: I told you, I wasn't spacing out, I was busy thinking over how we're gonna allocate the plate's subdivisions.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Besides, isn't Amiya supposed to be the handshaker for stuff like this?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: But you're Rhodes Chief Engineer.;But it was a plate transfer ceremony.;But Kal'tsit did leave primary responsibility with you.

attributes.content: I know, I'm just—*sigh*.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: There's no need to sigh, Closure. You've already done amazingly, honestly.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Photos can't speak. Who'll know you bungled Vina's name?

attributes.content: Duh, right! I totally forgot it was for a photo—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: But you DID look real embarrassed.

attributes.content: ...Doctor, for today only, the Rhodes Island Procurement Department will be hiking your quotes by 50%.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Have you no mercy?;......;But my hot water kettle JUST broke...

attributes.content: Hmph.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Haha...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Come to mention, Closure, when we first set out for Victoria from Rim Billiton, you were the one to drum up our spirits again, weren't you?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I mean, I found a little chocolate in the supplies we managed to rescue, and shared it around with whoever was closest. No big deal.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Plus you gave that rousing speech—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Alright, you can stop now—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But it really was a great source of encouragement for us.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Ugh!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Closure.

attributes.content: It's not too late to beg my forgiveness. You add any more fuel to the fire and Procurement's price hikes are gonna be...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: It's a tough road ahead.

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: I know it was Kal'tsit's will...;But if the burden's too heavy to shoulder...

attributes.content: ...Phew, I thought you were gonna gripe at me again.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Look, she left this to me. The only way for me is forward now. I'm not about to get cold feet—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure. Here.
attributes.name: Mechanist

attributes.content: ...Booze?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Take a swig, pull yourself together, then look over this. Engineering drew up preliminary spreadsheets for the plate renovations.
attributes.name: Mechanist

attributes.content: This is a lot of spreadsheets!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Sure is. Want a swig?
attributes.name: Mechanist

attributes.content: Pass.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This much is peanuts. If you want, I could draw you up a ream of spreadsheets thiiiiiiis thick.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Respect.
attributes.name: Mechanist

attributes.content: Doc, Amiya, I'm gonna go talk shop with Mechanist. You need anything, come find me, okay?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure's become so...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Dependable?;Concerned?;Good at putting on a brave face?

attributes.content: She's always been dependable, you know! It's just...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: So you're as concerned as I am...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Right. She has the greatest workload of anyone in Rhodes Island on her shoulders right now.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor, don't you think we should help by shouldering some of that burden?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Everyone heals in their own way.

attributes.content: You mean...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: I'm just making an educated guess.
Help her if you want, how you want, Amiya.

attributes.content: Right, right, right, cool, cool.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yep, we'll go with that. Call me again if there's any more fuss with the mobility layer. Bye-byeee.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Phew—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Man, it's been ringing off the hook all afternoon. What now...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yyyello?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: —The Snack Network got busted by Hibiscus?! I'll be right there!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Huh? She let us off...? You're telling me Hibiscus, Hibiscus, gave the Snack Network a pass?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...Yeah, that's fair. They work around the clock too these days, they need the energy top-up as much as we do... I forget she's grown. Everyone's grown.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This shipment's already earmarked for keeping our regulars supplied, though. I'll think of a way to cover Medical. Ciao.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Phew... small potatoes, small potatoes...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Hm?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I already know Medical wants in on the snack supply. Visiting me isn't gonna make it happen any faster—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Medical? Snack supply?
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: (Rubbing temples) Guess you're not here about that, then.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: We already agreed, didn't we? Check in with me for anything else, but run Medical's business your own damn self.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I know, but our department's stockpile is in trouble. That includes production of anti-Oripathy medication.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: The medical supplies are one thing, but pharmaceutical ingredients are a market commodity...
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Got it. No issues with the production equipment, right?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Not in itself. We're just out of ingredients, so nothing's operating.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Lemme see... We can procure this one from Kazimierz, and I'm... pretty sure there's manufacturing for this one at the Duke of Caster's, so we've gotta find a negotiator to run talks with her. This one's... uhh...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Origins for this one... guh, northern Leithanien... that's crazy far! Where's a small supply region somewhere closer... Tara?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Ugh, you're KIDDING me... Hold one sec, Warfarin...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: That you, Doc? Perfect, I dunno what you're calling about, but an order of business just came up here that I think has your name on it—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Huh? You already wrote to Na Saoirsí? Nice going, Doc, I owe you one. Is that what you called to tell me?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Sure, sure, sure, we'll have sandworm legs, they'll be on your desk tomorrow.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: All solved?
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Guess so.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Are you hanging in there?
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Hanging in there is my middle name! Anyway, if you're all settled, quit loitering here. I've still got debugging on ZOOT to run. You must be busy at Medical, yeah?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Not as busy as you are.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Don't often hear words like that out of your mouth. What, is Medical hoping for a budget increase?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm worried about you. How many hours of sleep a day have you been getting recently?
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: ...Enough to keep me alive.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm serious. You've had too much pressure on you lately.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Ugh, jeez, all you do is worry over nothing. Go on, scram.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Shrug)
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: *sigh* Seriously...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Four hours is plenty, and I split it up into four micronaps. Besides, I pulled this routine all the time back in Kazdel...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Yawn) Maybe I'll get an hour's snooze in now.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Lights off—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...Not a good moment, I take it?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Not the worst. What did A6—no, I know your problem kids are on best behavior these days. Aw, man... is it HR?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It is HR, in fact. We received a few resumes that... er, maybe you should get some sleep first. I'll come back in an hour—
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: No big. Pass 'em here.
attributes.name: Closure
Closure
attributes.content: Well, this one's a hard pass. Follow up on these two, though, set up face-to-face—

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: Don't tell me they're already at Reception?
No, not at all. Based on their addresses, you'll only be seeing them in a month at the earliest.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: One month... lemme see...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Will a month and a half out work?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I think we can arrange that.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Then a month and a half it is. Cheers.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Take care of yourself.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I gotta get some...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...sleep?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Damn, no. I need to keep it at four hours a day, and I need it in one-hour chunks. There's gotta be a solution...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Sleep's just one issue, anyway. I can't fall behind on Rhodes Island reconstruction work either. Ugh...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Lemme think... an alarm? No, just an alarm won't cut it. I need something smarter, more comprehensive, more reliable, and it's gotta be something that won't tax our available resources...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Mm-hm... only one thing for it.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure?
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: (Even breathing)
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: She's asleep...
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: In that case, I'll just leave Dr. Warfarin's report right...
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: Detected keyword 'Warfarin'! Detonation imminent—
attributes.name: THRM-EX

attributes.content: Deploying thermal shock!
attributes.name: THRM-EX

attributes.content: WHOAAAAAAAA! WARFARIN! What's up with Warfarin?!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: C-Closure?
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: (Rubs eyes) Oh, it's you. Go on, what does Medical need?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: A shipment of pharmaceutical ingredients arrived from Tara, and they're not up to the same standard as the batch before... but Medical was hesitant to jump the cannon. Take a look...
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: ...I'll head there now.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: By the way, what did THRM-EX just...?
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: Oh, there's been a ton on my plate recently, right? So I took the liberty of 'mobilizing' all the support robots a little.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: THRM-EX sits by my side while I'm sleeping now. He's got a new keyword capture unit, so if he detects one, he can wake me up.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: With... an explosion?
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: Potayto potahto, tomayto tomahto. Let's hustle down to Medical, alright?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Nice, nice. I think with this, work on the Training Room's pretty much a wrap. You're gonna put me out of a job at this rate.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Far from it.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: Alright, I've gotta head down to—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Hold it.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: I know, I'll bug Engineering to deliver you the testing-spec practice targets ASAP. And if it's about ZOOT's reservation system, that's almost done with debugging too. I've been stretched thin the last few days, just hold on a little longer...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: Look, I'm only gonna be this real with you because it's you, but I'm drowning in all this work. I'm only getting an hour and a half of sleep a day at this point—do NOT make me hear it!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Calm. I have no intent to beleaguer you.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: ...*exhale*.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: If you require rest, I could deliver you an incantation.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: I appreciate the sentiment. It's not like I can't sleep at night, I've just got too much on my plate to—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: See? Just talking about it summons the damn...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yes? They confiscated a Procurement shipment at the checkpoint? I—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Who is this? The Oripathy meds? I said those were Warfarin's bailiwick... These are for keeping the Reception Room stocked? Uh, okay, that is my turf...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The corner four-person dorm rooms' beds don't fit? You're kidding me, we ordered those to fit—did our supplier pinch pennies on us?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm warning you now, I have enough small potatoes as it is, and if it's not major, I WILL hang up! I'm BUSY here!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: —ZOOT errored out again?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The young Banshee watches with some concern as the Vampire fishes out four terminals at once and sets about attacking four problems at once in complete disorder, almost as if she's arguing with herself.
Closure—
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: Don't, don't worry, I like potatoes. This is how it is, people want me all around the clock for stuff.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Castle-3!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Launch auto-recovery mode.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Without waiting for a response to her command, the Vampire dismantles a portion of Castle-3's outer hull, and connects the four terminals...
...as well as three more of her as-of-yet quiet terminals to Castle-3, one by one.
I'll just have Castle-3 sort any simultaneously incoming comms by order of priority...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: And anything that's not too important, he can stave off with a quick response, while I deal with the urgent stuff first.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: What do you think? Smart, right?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Anyway, enough jibber-jabber, I've got ZOOT to attend to! Let's go, Castle-3!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Hey, you're here.
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: Closure!
attributes.name: Goldenglow

attributes.content: *huff*, *pant*, *pant*...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Blaze, Gol... Goldenglow. You sort everything out at the Gododdin branch?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yup. Just little hiccups. Here's the report.
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: Cool, you can... put it here.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure... are you feeling poorly?
attributes.name: Goldenglow

attributes.content: No. I'm good.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But... you've got horrible bags under your eyes. It almost looks like you have eye masks on.
attributes.name: Goldenglow

attributes.content: That—okay, I want a haircut next time that'll hide my dark circles, deal?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Just so happens I got the hair salon fixed up, GG. Go see if it suits you. If you've got any complaints, I want them submitted to me in writing.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Alright! Thank you, Closure!
attributes.name: Goldenglow

attributes.content: ...Way to get li'l Susie out of your hair like that.
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: Who's getting who out of whose hair?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Okay. Why don't you tell me what Lancet-2's doing stuck to your side?
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: She... she just likes going on walks with me—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Lovely Ms. Closure, the results of my calculations indicate a: Thirty-seven point nine percent chance you can enter sleep mode in the next ten minutes.
attributes.name: Lancet-2

attributes.content: Latest update. Justice Knight is forcibly inviting Operator Chiave to a game of Barrage Fortress in order to delay his travel. The chance you can enter sleep mode has risen to: Fifty one point nought percent.
attributes.name: Lancet-2

attributes.content: I recommend you take a brief rest in this period.
attributes.name: Lancet-2

attributes.content: There you have it. Excuse me while I go snooze!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure—
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: She...
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: *sigh*.
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: PhonoR-0? If it's not urgent, it can wait. I'm gonna take a sec to—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I know. A ten-minute sleep.
attributes.name: PhonoR-0

attributes.content: Don't bother me right now, then. You want a matte pink livery?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Regrettably for you, such a threat would only work on Mr. Friston-3.
attributes.name: PhonoR-0

attributes.content: Whose condition you know has been maladious of late, else it would not fall on my shoulders to advise you in your work.
attributes.name: PhonoR-0

attributes.content: Your workload is only set to increase further. To consult Lancet-2's statistics, your average time spent not working per day is: Fifty-nine minutes.
attributes.name: PhonoR-0

attributes.content: Then stop camping my sleeping time if you know already. I'm warning you, I don't need Logos to incant at me, and I don't need your—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Lovely Ms. Closure, latest update. Your chance of entering sleep mode in the next twenty-four hours is: One hundred percent.
attributes.name: Lancet-2

attributes.content: ...Did your system bug?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: All communications resolved. No new communications are forecast for the next twenty-four hours.
attributes.name: Castle-3

attributes.content: Once you returned to the Engineering Department, my keyword capture module did not capture any keywords worth waking you up over.
attributes.name: THRM-EX

attributes.content: Beep-beep. Operator Chiave lost in a Barrage Fortress duel and resolved to polish his gaming skills. He has now gone to look for Operators Broca and Aosta.
attributes.name: 'Justice Knight'

attributes.content: Am I hallucinating? From overwork? Is that what this is?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Worried gaze)
attributes.name: Friston-3

attributes.content: Well, you still look normal at least. Are they telling the truth, Mr. Friston?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Friston-3

attributes.content: I can actually get some sleep?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...Yes.
attributes.name: Friston-3

attributes.content: You're due for some rest.
attributes.name: Friston-3

attributes.content: I dunno, something about this still seems super weird to me, but...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Whatever! I'm sleeping!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The obviously exhausted Vampire flops headlong onto a camp bed in the corner.
...losure.
Shaddup... whozzit...?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure.
Mom, I told you I'm not coming down from the loft. Leave me alone—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Your Highness?! Why are you here? Don't tell me—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm here to laud you for your diligence.
Huh?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: That's weird, I've got this vague feeling that's not what you're supposed to say, it'd be more like 'I'm looking for someone who can break the shackles of tradition' or something...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The shackles of tradition? You've already broken them.
H—Have I?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But I... uh, look, I'm just someone who does random crap in my loft. All that Kazdel's Elite 100 stuff, I made it up. Nothing about me screams diligence, haha...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Besides, this is the first time you've ever met me, I...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Is it really?
R—Right, we've known each other for... ages? It's been... forever since I saw you? But...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The Vampire feels her head being softly caressed by a pair of strange yet deeply familiar hands, and she can't help but sniffle.
Now, now. We can reminisce about the olden days later. Right now, I wonder if any amount of praise would be enough to reward all your achievements.
Come. Let's see the fruits of your efforts.
Where are we...?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Surely you haven't forgotten? This is what you strove for, and in the end, fully completed... This is the New Rhodes Island.
Strove... completed... New Rhodes Island...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Right! Yeah, that sounds familiar!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Aha, ahahahahah, work's finally over... it's finally over!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Your Highness, I need to thank you for reminding me. I always felt like I'd be at this for another half a month at least, another half a half without basically any sleep...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This is the playroom you poured your heart into designing. How lengthily you wracked your brains, wanting to remind our operators of times past, yet not so much as to stir their emotions turbid...
How do you... know I...?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This is the mobility layer, one to match that of any nomadic city upon this great land. The sleep you lost, the meals you forewent, to upgrade the plate's propulsion systems...
This... is the Medical Department.
Closure, we've got an issue here...
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Y-Your Highness, isn't there still unfinished work here I have to...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Don't fret.
This figure of Closure's dream weaves an Arts she's never seen before, and in a blink, the whole plate suddenly shudders a few times, before softly rumbling to life.
Wh-What was that?
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Closure has completed all that she can. Now comes my turn to help her a little.
With the help of Arts, all that is here will no longer trouble Closure. All that is left for her to do is nod a few times, pen a few signatures, and push a few buttons.
Really? Let me see...
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: What? The issue really is gone! How?
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Let us go, Closure. To the destination of this journey, and the most important of places. The Engineering Department.
Wow... everything is exactly like how I envisioned it. More advanced comms systems, more accessible control logic, and all the footfall circulates around the place just how I like it...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Your Highness, I...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Shouldn't this be a happy occasion? Come, don't shed such tears.
I just... feel like—it was so much struggle—to get to this point...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I don't mean the timeline of this thing, it started... so much earlier, it started when you pushed open my door...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Back then, I never imagined some nonconformist Vampire screwing around in databases would have Her Highness Theresa trusting her with all this responsibility...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Whenever I argued with my folks, it was the way they harped on about 'duty' that made me maddest. What did a Vampire's duty have to do with me?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But you love to build things.
...I do.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It went from weird and wacky terminals in Kazdel, to building Babel, to building Rhodes Island...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Be they data or constructs, your unending passion to build the things you've built has helped more than you can know... and as a matter of course, brought responsibility upon your shoulders.
And never have you shied away.
*sniff*...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Your Highness... oh, erm, I wish you could—and I wish Kal'tsit—could...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Huh? Your Highness... Your Highness, aren't you right here? Why am I... huh?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Let's forget the gloomy talk for now. Come, take a look at your present. A present like no other, for you and you alone.
The chair in the center of the room? That wasn't in my blueprints.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: That is the Rhodes Island Chief Engineer's throne.
A—A throne?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: From now on, all you need to do is sit atop this throne... and eat chocolate.
Eat chocolate?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: If chocolate is not your desire, there are also potato chips here, and candied fruits, and biscuits...
No, Your Highness, I mean... what about my work?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...After so long exhausting yourself, do you truly wish to return to work?
I... ugh...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Well, of course I don't wanna work if I don't have to! But—just sitting here eating chocolate, I feel like... even if witchcraft could solve all my problems, I'd still wanna... ugh...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I can't figure out how to word it, but this doesn't seem right. I need to... ugh, I need to...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Then farewell, until we meet again, Closure.
What? You're gonna say goodbye to me just because I don't wanna sit on a throne eating chocolate?!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Don't—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Ah, you're awake.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Warfarin, you did something shady to me, didn't you?! Fess up, what did you make me drink?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Cross my heart and hope to die, she didn't do anything.
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: I can attest to the same.
attributes.name: Medic

attributes.content: Then it was you, Logos! I told you I don't need your incantations—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: You went to sleep all by yourself.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: ...I went to sleep by myself? Me?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Oh, I get it now, all the bots kept pushing me to sleep... Mechanist, what did you do to them?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Holds up hands defensively) All the info they told you was the truth. Besides, they're your domain. No one on Rhodes Island knows them better than you.
attributes.name: Mechanist

attributes.content: Still, good thing you're awake now. I was almost gonna wager with Logos whether you'd wake up before someone woke you up.
attributes.name: Mechanist

attributes.content: ...Apologies.
attributes.name: Logos

attributes.content: Alright, alright, all's well that ends well. Let's all get back to our posts now!
attributes.name: Blaze

attributes.content: In short order, most of the people in Engineering empty out.
I vaguely remember Lancet-2 telling me something about twenty-four hours... How long was I out?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure, you slept... exactly twenty-four hours.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You slept a whole day and night without any sign of waking up. That's why we were all gathered here, discussing whether or not to wake you.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: A whole day and night?! Oh, crap, I'm so screwed! I can kiss goodbye to sleeping for the whole of next month at this rate—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Not so fast.

attributes.content: You're here too, Doc?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Amiya's been worried sick about you.;I've been worried sick about you.;Everyone's been worried sick about you.
So, while you were sleeping...
Amiya had us all divvy up your work.

attributes.content: *exhale*...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Thank you. All of you, so much.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: I helped draw up your daily itinerary, too.;I reassigned some of the less critical work for you.
Now you'll get five, six hours a night, minimum.

attributes.content: Once again, thank you. And also, all your chocolate and chips and fruit candy and cookies for the next month are free of charge.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: But you can't be Kal'tsit.

attributes.content: Doctor, I don't really wanna get into this right now—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: You can inherit her all-consuming sense of mission...
But overwork won't transform you into her.
There are other ways to prove her will lives on in you.

attributes.content: Rebuilding Rhodes Island is a job with a thousand faces. You've suffered more than enough for it, Closure.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I hope, with the Doctor's adjustments, your work schedule can allow you to breathe a little easier.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The Elite Ops are all busy with their own stuff too. You sure allocating my work to them won't be too much trouble?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Beats seeing a repeat of your last couple days.

attributes.content: ...Hrmph.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Wait.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Since you care so much about me, Doc, mayyyybe I could sleep another eight hours or so...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure looks at the Doctor, face brimming with expectation, only to notice a strange shift in the expression concealed beneath the hood, after which...
Why'd the Doc just fall over like a plank?!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The Doctor hasn't... caught a wink of sleep in the last twenty-four hours either.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Blah. Never mind, then.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Besides, seems like things aren't so urgent now. Don't mind me while I goof off a little—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Master Closure, I have three unanswered calls the Doctor was not able to pick up within five minutes. They came respectively from the Engineering, Medical, and Procurement Departments—
attributes.name: Castle-3

attributes.content: AUGH!!!
attributes.name: Closure
